description:
Configure an automated map generation layout (Atlas) for Brazil.

1. Open QGIS and load the countries layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp.
2. Create a new Print Layout named 'Country_Report'.
3. Add a map item to the layout.
4. Enable 'Atlas' in the layout settings.
5. Set the Coverage Layer to the countries layer.
6. Set a Filter Expression to isolate Brazil (e.g., "NAME" = 'Brazil').
7. Configure the Map Item properties to be 'Controlled by Atlas' so it zooms to the current feature.
8. Export the Atlas (or the current view) as a PDF to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/brazil_atlas_map.pdf.
9. Save the project as /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/atlas_project.qgz.
